name: example-webgl-particle-galaxy
title: Particle Galaxy
description: Build a swirling particle galaxy — tens of thousands of additive-blended GPU points spiraling around a bright core, their orbits solved in the vertex shader — rendered live at 60fps as a single self-contained index.html.

useCase.query: Build a swirling GPU particle galaxy as a single self-contained index.html: tens of thousands of points whose orbits are solved in the vertex shader from gl_VertexID (a log-spiral disk with an inner-fast rotation curve), additive-blended into glowing arms around a bright core, at 60fps.
